newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS keeps Danzas as "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS keeps Danzas as "hold".

text.p: UBS equities analyst Andres Gujan said in a study the bank cut its earnings forecast for Swiss freight forwarding firm Danzas, but was keeping its recommendation for the share as a "hold."
It cut its earnings estimate to 38 million Swiss francs for 1997 from 192 million, and lowered the estimate for 1998 to 53.7 million from 41.2 million.
Earnings per share are forecast to rise to 75.4 francs in 1997 and to 106.5 in 1998, from 25.8 in 1996.

"The rigorous restructuring program 'Eurofit' is going according to plan. Against this background and the fact that the company has paid out 58 million francs in provisions (for the program), earnings of 13 million Swiss francs in 1996 are disappointing," the study said.

"There is doubt whether 'Eurofit' will be able to achieve the expected earnings gain of 100 million Swiss francs EBIT by 1998. We are therefore reducing our earnings estimate and retain our recommendation for hold," it said.
It said the favourite in the sector remained Kuehne & Nagel.
